text.name: Remoraid
text.flavor: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

text.name: Octillery

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Rapid Strike Search
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Rapid Strike card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Rapid Strike Search Ability each turn.

text.flavor: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

text.name: Manaphy

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Wave Veil
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

text.flavor: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

text.name: Sobble

attacks.name: Keep Calling
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Rapid Strike Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

text.flavor: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

text.name: Inteleon

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Quick Shooting
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

text.flavor: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

text.name: Drizzile

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Shady Dealings
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

text.name: Inteleon

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Shady Dealings
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Trainer cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Aqua Bullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

attacks.name: Yoga Loop
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by this attack, take another turn after this one. (Skip Pokémon Checkup.) If 1 of your Pokémon used Yoga Loop during your last turn, this attack can't be used.

attacks.name: Smash Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Strafe
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Gale Thrust
attacks.text: If this Pokémon moved from your Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does 120 more damage.

attacks.name: G-Max Rapid Flow
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: VMAX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Cheryl
effect: Heal all damage from each of your Evolution Pokémon. If you do, discard all Energy from the Pokémon that were healed in this way.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Escape Rope
effect: Each player switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. Your opponent switches first. (If a player does not have a Benched Pokémon, they don't switch Pokémon.)

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Level Ball
effect: Search your deck for a Pokémon with 90 HP or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Boss's Orders
effect: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Tool Jammer
effect: As long as the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, Pokémon Tools attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon have no effect, except for Tool Jammer.

rules.label: Pokémon Tool
rules.text: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Tower of Waters
effect: The Retreat Cost of each Rapid Strike Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) is {Colorless}{Colorless} less.

rules.text: This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Rapid Strike Energy
effect: This card can only be attached to a Rapid Strike Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Rapid Strike Pokémon, discard this card.
As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides 2 in any combination of {Water} Energy and {Fighting} Energy.

text.name: Hisuian Heavy Ball
effect: Look at your face-down Prize cards. You may reveal a Basic Pokémon you find there, put it into your hand, and put this Hisuian Heavy Ball in its place as a face-down Prize card. (If you don't reveal a Basic Pokémon, put this card in the discard pile.) Then, shuffle your face-down Prize cards.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Irida
effect: Search your deck for a {Water} Pokémon and an Item card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Ultra Ball
effect: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.
Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Roxanne
effect: You can use this card only if your opponent has 3 or fewer Prize cards remaining.
Each player shuffles their hand into their deck. Then, you draw 6 cards, and your opponent draws 2 cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Rescue Carrier
effect: Put up to 2 Pokémon, each with 90 HP or less, from your discard pile into your hand.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Energy Search
effect: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Evolution Incense
effect: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Scoop Up Net
effect: Put 1 of your Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon V or a Pokémon-GX into your hand. (Discard all attached cards.)

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Marnie
effect: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, you draw 5 cards, and your opponent draws 4 cards.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Ordinary Rod
effect: Choose 1 or both:
• Shuffle up to 2 Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck.
• Shuffle up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Pal Pad
effect: Shuffle up to 2 Supporter cards from your discard pile into your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Quick Ball
effect: You can play this card only if you discard another card from your hand.
Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.
